title: api-config-telemetry-and-metrics-draft
content:
Notes: telemetry + metrics for API config (runtime)

Purpose:
- Capture structured events and aggregated metrics for inference requests to support: SLO monitoring, cost estimation, cache/batch effectiveness, and offline quality/regression analysis.
- Provide a configurable sampling system so we can keep event volume manageable while ensuring enough samples for debugging and evals.

Goals:
- Define a minimal event schema that runtime can emit with low overhead.
- Decide default sampling rates and per-tenant override mechanism.
- Sketch sinks (metrics vs events vs traces) and retention expectations.

Telemetry events (sketch):
- request.received: tags: model, route, tenant, priority
- request.routed: tags: route_target, pool, model_variant
- inference.start
- inference.end
- kv_cache.hit / kv_cache.miss
- batching.batch_created
- batching.batch_sent
- response.streamed
- error.occurred
Each event should carry: trace_id, request_id, timestamp, model_version, seq_len, tokens_generated, cost_estimate (optional)

Metrics (aggregations):
- P50/P95/P99 latency per route/model
- tokens_generated per minute (by model)
- throughput (requests/s) per capacity pool
- cache hit rate (prefix-level)
- batch size distribution
- e2e success rate / error rate
- per-tenant request rate (sampled, not full cardinality counters)

Sampling and volume control:
- sample 100% for failed requests
- reservoir sample 1% for successful by default, adjustable per-customer
- low-cardinality tags only in high-volume counters; high-cardinality attributes go into sampled events/logs/spans

Config schema sketch (YAML-like):
telemetry:
  enabled: true
  sampling:
    default_success: 0.01
    failure: 1.0
    per_tenant_overrides:
      'tenant-id-123': 0.1
  enrichers:
    - trace
    - route
    - model_profile
  sinks:
    - metrics: prometheus
    - events: kafka://telemetry-events
    - traces: jaeger

ASCII flow (request -> telemetry points):
client -> api-gateway -> auth -> router -> runtime
             |             |         |
             v             v         v
     request.received   request.routed  inference.start
                                    inference.end -> response.streamed

Open questions / tradeoffs:
- kafka vs firehose: kafka gives ordering/retention but operational cost; firehose cheaper/easier to ingest to bigquery
- how to attach cost_estimate per request without leaking pricing to logs? store numeric estimate in sampled event (no billing ids)
- retention policy: events 90 days; aggregated metrics 13 months; traces 30 days? confirm with compliance
- privacy: PII redaction rules; should we strip user prompt text from telemetry by default? likely yes, but keep hashed prompt fingerprint for regressions

TODO:

- create Confluence page with final schema + mapping to metrics (link to CON-telemetry-setup)
- spike: compare cpu/memory overhead of adding enrichers (trace + model_profile) on hot path
- proposal for default sampling values and per-tenant override API

Action items:
- Samir: prototype kafka producer (ENG-1248)
- Priya: confirm data retention and compliance constraints with security
- Alex: mock dashboard for cache hit rate + batch size distribution
- Me (Jamie): consolidate schema and send to eng-telemetry review by 2026-03-05

Notes-to-self:
- keep metric tag cardinality low for prometheus (no tenant ids on counters; use labels only for per-tenant pushgateway or per-tenant prometheus)
- use histograms for latency with buckets aligned to SLOs (10ms,50ms,100ms,200ms,500ms,1s,5s)
- consider exporting raw sampled events to bigquery for offline quality evaluation
